stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: She can manage the busy community kitchen calmly.
items.sentenceZh: 她能从容地管理繁忙的社区厨房。
items.scene: An adult kitchen coordinator calmly directs three simultaneous tasks in a busy community kitchen: one cook prepares vegetables, another checks an oven and a volunteer packs meals. Her open-hand gestures, orderly stations and attentive oversight communicate successful management without lists, labels or readable text.
items.altText: 社区厨房负责人从容协调备菜、烘烤和打包三项工作。

items.sentenceEn: The wooden chair stands beside the window.
items.sentenceZh: 木椅放在窗边。
items.scene: Exactly one well-crafted wooden chair stands beside a sunlit window in a quiet room, fully visible from backrest to four legs. A folded blanket rests on the seat, while no other chair, stool or chair-shaped object appears.
items.altText: 一把完整可见的木椅放在阳光照进来的窗边。

items.sentenceEn: Six colorful fish swim around the coral.
items.sentenceZh: 六条彩色的鱼在珊瑚周围游动。
items.scene: Exactly six distinct colorful fish swim around one coral formation in clear shallow water. Every fish is fully visible and easy to count, with no additional fish silhouettes, fish-shaped decorations or other animals.
items.altText: 正好六条清晰可数的彩色鱼围绕一簇珊瑚游动。

items.sentenceEn: She chooses one particular apple from the basket.
items.sentenceZh: 她从篮子里挑出某一个特定的苹果。
items.scene: At a fruit stall, an adult shopper reaches decisively for one particular apple with a small natural leaf while many otherwise similar apples remain in the basket. Her finger, gaze and hand all converge on that single selected apple, with no arrows, circles or text.
items.altText: 顾客的目光、手指和手掌都指向篮子里一只带叶子的特定苹果。

items.meaningZh: 照相机；摄影机；密谈室；暗箱
items.sentenceEn: The traveler uses a camera to photograph the old bridge.
items.sentenceZh: 旅行者用相机拍摄老桥。
items.scene: An adult traveler holds one clearly recognizable camera to her eye and photographs an old stone bridge. The lens points directly toward the bridge, a strap hangs naturally, and no phone or second camera appears.
items.altText: 旅行者把一台相机举到眼前，镜头对准远处的老石桥。

items.meaningZh: 结构；构造；建筑物；构成；组织
items.sentenceEn: Steel beams form the structure of the new hall.
items.sentenceZh: 钢梁构成新大厅的结构。
items.scene: A partially built community hall is shown in a clean cutaway view, with its connected steel columns, crossbeams and roof trusses clearly exposed before walls are added. Two helmeted adult builders inspect the stable framework from a safe distance.
items.altText: 未封墙的新大厅露出由立柱、横梁和屋架组成的钢制结构。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors discuss local politics at a public meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们在公开会议上讨论地方政治。
items.scene: A diverse group of adult neighbors takes turns speaking at a calm public meeting while an elected local representative listens at the same round table. A text-free neighborhood map and small models of a park, homes and a bus route make civic decision-making visible. No flags, party colors, campaign signs, slogans or real politicians.
items.altText: 邻居们与地方代表围坐讨论公园、住宅和公交等社区事务。

items.meaningZh: 进行；履行；完成；执行；表演
items.sentenceEn: The musicians perform for the evening audience.
items.sentenceZh: 音乐家们为晚间观众表演。
items.scene: Three adult musicians actively perform on a small theater stage with a violin, cello and hand drum while a seated audience watches attentively. Stage lighting, coordinated playing poses and visible audience focus make the performance unmistakable.
items.altText: 三位音乐家在小剧场舞台上合奏，观众专注观看。

items.meaningZh: 一点；少量；比特；二进制位；钻头
items.sentenceEn: Only a bit of water remains in the bottle.
items.sentenceZh: 瓶里只剩下一点水。
items.scene: One transparent upright bottle is almost completely empty, with only a very shallow pool of water remaining at the bottom. The large empty interior compared with the tiny amount of water clearly communicates a bit, with no drops or extra containers nearby.
items.altText: 透明瓶几乎全空，仅在底部剩下很浅的一点水。

items.sentenceEn: The scale shows the weight of the stone.
items.sentenceZh: 秤显示了石头的重量。
items.scene: A sturdy two-pan balance scale compares one stone with several plain metal weights. The stone's pan hangs lower while the opposite pan rises, clearly showing the stone's weight through physical balance. No numbers, labels or readable markings.
items.altText: 天平一侧放着石头，另一侧放着砝码，石头一侧更低。

items.sentenceEn: A strong gust suddenly turns his umbrella inside out.
items.sentenceZh: 一阵强风突然把他的伞吹翻了。
items.scene: On a rainy street, one sudden gust has just flipped an adult walker's umbrella inside out. His startled expression, windblown coat, diagonal rain and sharply bent umbrella capture the abrupt instant, with no injury or fall.
items.altText: 雨街上突来强风，把行人的一把伞猛地吹翻，他露出惊讶表情。

items.sentenceEn: The researchers discover a fossil beneath the sand.
items.sentenceZh: 研究人员在沙下发现了一块化石。
items.scene: Two adult field researchers carefully brush sand away as a previously hidden spiral fossil emerges in a shallow excavation. One points with delighted surprise while the other continues brushing, making the moment of discovery clear without labels or text.
items.altText: 两位研究人员刷开沙土，惊喜地发现一块刚露出的螺旋化石。

items.meaningZh: 候选人；投考者；候选；候补者
items.sentenceEn: The candidate presents her design to the selection panel.
items.sentenceZh: 候选人向评选小组展示她的设计。
items.scene: Exactly one adult candidate stands beside a text-free model of a small public garden and presents it to three seated selection-panel members. Her portfolio is closed, the panel evaluates attentively, and the formal selection context is clear without badges or writing.
items.altText: 一名候选人向三位评选人员展示公共花园模型。

items.meaningZh: 生产；制作；产量；生产环境（软件）
items.sentenceEn: Bicycle production moves through several careful stages.
items.sentenceZh: 自行车生产经过几个细致的阶段。
items.scene: A compact bicycle workshop shows a clear left-to-right production flow: frames are assembled, wheels are fitted, finished bicycles are inspected and then rolled toward packing. Adult workers use safe tools at distinct stations, with no arrows, labels, logos or readable text.
items.altText: 自行车依次经过车架组装、装轮、检验和包装等生产工序。

items.sentenceEn: The nurse will treat the child's small scrape.
items.sentenceZh: 护士会处理孩子的小擦伤。
items.scene: In a bright clinic, an adult nurse gently cleans a child's tiny knee scrape with gauze while a parent offers reassurance. The child is calm and seated safely. Show only mild pink skin, with no blood, open wound, needle or graphic medical detail.
items.altText: 明亮诊室里，护士用纱布轻柔处理孩子膝盖上的小擦伤。

items.sentenceEn: The family begins a train trip through the mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 一家人开始乘火车穿越群山的旅行。
items.scene: A family of three settles into a train compartment as the train travels through a broad mountain valley. Small luggage, wide windows and their shared excitement establish a journey in progress. No tickets, maps, station signs or readable text.
items.altText: 一家三口带着行李坐在列车中，窗外是正在经过的山谷。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors share dinner in the warm evening.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们在温暖的傍晚共进晚餐。
items.scene: Several adult neighbors share dinner at an outdoor courtyard table during twilight. The sun has just set, the sky transitions from orange to deep blue, the first stars appear and warm house lights begin glowing, clearly conveying evening rather than day or full night.
items.altText: 日落后的庭院中，邻居们在橙蓝暮色和初亮灯光下共进晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: A long drought can affect the young plants.
items.sentenceZh: 长期干旱会影响幼苗。
items.scene: A gardener kneels beside young plants drooping in cracked dry soil beneath a hot cloudless sky. Nearby, an empty rain barrel and the gardener's concerned expression make the drought's harmful effect on the plants clear, without diagrams, arrows or text.
items.altText: 长期无雨后，干裂土壤中的幼苗萎蔫，园丁担忧地查看。

items.sentenceEn: The kitten is hiding inside the cardboard box.
items.sentenceZh: 小猫藏在纸箱里面。
items.scene: Exactly one kitten sits fully inside one open cardboard box, with only its head and front paws peeking above the rim while its body is visibly enclosed by the box walls. No other animals, boxes or box-shaped containers appear.
items.altText: 一只小猫身体藏在一个敞开的纸箱里面，头和前爪露出箱沿。

items.sentenceEn: Researchers exchange ideas at the annual conference.
items.sentenceZh: 研究人员在年度会议上交流想法。
items.scene: In a modern conference room, diverse adult researchers sit around one long table while one presenter explains a text-free scientific diagram on a large board. Name placards are blank, notebooks contain no readable writing, and attentive discussion clearly establishes a formal conference.
items.altText: 现代会议室里，研究人员围坐长桌，一位演讲者用无文字图示交流研究想法。
